title: 2020 Audi R8 V10 Performance Quattro Coupe

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2020 Audi R8 V10 Performance Quattro Coupe, finished in Ibis White with a black interior. The odometer currently displays about 12,400 miles. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents or mileage inconsistencies in this Audi's past. Modifications reported by the selling dealer include an MTM supercharger kit, 20-inch Vossen wheels, a lowered suspension system, tinted windows, and an aftermarket steering wheel. According to the build sheet provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes a carbon-ceramic braking system, a dynamic steering system, black exterior emblems, a fixed rear spoiler, carbon fiber interior trim, Express Red stitching, heated and power-adjustable sport seats, the Virtual Cockpit digital instrument cluster, and a Bang & Olufsen sound system. Introduced for 2017, the second-generation R8 received rave reviews from enthusiasts and journalists alike. It's powered by a naturally-aspirated, 5.2-liter V10 that's closely related to the engine found in the Lamborghini Huracán, and it offers drivers a fun blend of mid-engined handling and all-wheel-drive sure-footedness. 2020 brought a mid-cycle update that included styling revisions inspired by the racing version of the R8 and more power, and the R8 retired without a successor in 2024. Power comes from a 5.2-liter supercharged V10, rated at 602 horsepower and 413 lb-ft of torque when left stock and naturally aspirated. Due to the modifications performed to this R8, it may produce more power, but a dyno sheet was not provided to confirm. Output is sent to all four wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission.
sections.Equipment: A build sheet is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment includes: Carbon-ceramic braking system Red brake calipers Dynamic steering system LED exterior lighting Black exterior emblems Carbon fiber door mirror caps Carbon fiber side blades Fixed rear spoiler Leather upholstery Express Red stitching Carbon fiber interior trim Heated and power-adjustable seats Heated and power-folding door mirrors Virtual Cockpit digital instrument cluster MMI infotainment system Bang & Olufsen sound system Navigation system Front and rear parking sensors
sections.Seller Notes: Due to the modifications performed to this R8, it may not pass emissions testing in some states. As always, it's the buyer's responsibility to perform all due diligence regarding registering this Audi in their respective state prior to placing a bid.
